# The Weekly 2% Edge

> Deep-dive case studies of the exact tools Daan uses to buy back time: the honest stack, with live trading system updates. Last updated 2026-06-14.

Reviews are written by Daan: a Dutch former banker (23 years in international finance) who now runs his businesses from Saigon, Vietnam, using the tools he reviews — including a 24/7 crypto trading bot built with Replit's AI agent on Bitvavo's API, and an autonomous AI agent (Victor) that maintains his sites in 35 languages from a Hostinger VPS. Hands-on reviews reflect real, personal use.

## Key pages
- [The stack](https://theweekly2pctedge.com/stack.html): the complete tool stack in daily use
- [Hands-on tool reviews](https://aibuildermarketplace.com/b2b/): canonical versions of the stack reviews (Gamma, Reclaim, SaneBox, ClickUp and more)
